question: How many streetlights exist in Mumbai?
idealClarificationQuestions: All public streetlights (BMC + Highway authority + private township)? Yes.
Greater Mumbai? Yes (BMC + Thane + Navi Mumbai roads where applicable).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai (BMC) road network: ~2,000 km of roads.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~3-3.5 lakh streetlights in Greater Mumbai.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 25-30 m on urban arterial roads = ~70-80 lights/km.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus private township + societies + alley lighting (smaller intensity)

calculationFlow: Average streetlight spacing: 25-30 m on urban arterial roads = ~70-80 lights/km.
Plus Greater Mumbai (Thane + Navi Mumbai): roads ~2,500 km × 60 = ~1.5 lakh.
Plus private township + societies + alley lighting (smaller intensity): ~50K extra.
Round: ~3-3.5 lakh streetlights in Greater Mumbai.
